name: What factors determine the cost of installing bathroom wall tile?

mainEntity.name: What factors determine the cost of installing bathroom wall tile?

acceptedAnswer.text: The overall cost of bathroom wall tile installation depends on square footage, tile material, wall preparation, and plumbing layout complexity. Basic ceramic tile is the most budget-friendly, while natural stone, glass, or handmade zellige tiles increase both material and labor costs due to specialized cutting needs. If older walls have hidden water damage, rotted studs, or uneven framing, rebuilding the substrate adds to the scope. Custom details like recessed shower niches, decorative borders, and bench seating also increase the labor required compared to a flat, straight wall layout.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs depend on wall square footage, chosen tile material, necessary surface prep or moisture repair, and custom features like built-in niches.
